summary_en: ¥136/share interim dividend (up ¥15 from ¥121 prior forecast); year-end dividend forecast raised to ¥136 (up ¥15); full-year dividend ¥272/share (up ¥30 from ¥242 prior forecast). Total interim distribution ¥241,536 million, effective 2026-09-01. Raised following upward revision to FY2026 earnings outlook.
title_en: Notice regarding dividend increase and revision of dividend forecast
translation_en_brief: Japan Tobacco announced on 30 July 2026 that its board has approved an increase to the interim and full-year dividend for fiscal year 2026 (year ending 31 December 2026). The interim dividend per share is set at ¥136, up ¥15 from the prior forecast of ¥121, with a total distribution of ¥241,536 million payable on 1 September 2026. The year-end dividend forecast has been raised to ¥136 per share, also up ¥15. Consequently, the full-year dividend is now expected to reach ¥272 per share, up ¥30 from the prior forecast of ¥242 per share (prior year actual: ¥234). The increases reflect upward revision of consolidated earnings for the second quarter cumulative period and the full-year outlook, resulting in parent company net income exceeding the initial forecast, in accordance with the group's shareholder return policy.
